description: Weekly run, any time on Saturday, Moscow time; a release is offered once it is 7 days old.
Minor and patch updates: one PR per package manager. Majors: only after approval in the Dependency Dashboard.
No automerge. Security fixes bypass the schedule, the release age and the approval.
Lock files are re-resolved in the same weekly run, without the release age: Renovate fixes vulnerable direct dependencies only, and this reaches the transitive ones.
